main_text.head: CAPVT VI

p.i: Ericho autem erat clausa & claudebatur propter filios Israel, nec poterat quisquam egredi vel ingredi.

main_text.p: 2 Dixitque Iehoua ad Iosuam, Ecce tradidi in manum tuam Iericho, & regem eius, & virtute præstantes.
3 Circuibitis itaque vrbem, omnes viri bellatores circundando eā semel: sic facies sex diebus.
4 Porrò septem sacerdotes ferent septem cornua arietina ante arcā: Die autem septima circuibitis vrbem septem vicibus, & sacerdotes ipsi clangent tubis.

5 Quum verò protraxerint sonitum cornu arietino: vbi primum audieritis vocem tubæ, vociferabitur vniuersus populus vociferatione magna, & concidet murus vrbis sub se: populus verò ascendet quisque è regione sua.

page.notes: Verse numbers 1–5 are printed at the start of each verse. The drop-cap I at the start of verse 1 is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "Ericho" with the initial omitted, as the printed text reads "Ericho". Text is as printed; the word "Ericho" in verse 1 stands with its initial letter as a decorated capital.
